data.name: ChooseModel
data.value: Choose the charger's model on this page, or save its address: the check tells the two apart.

data.name: ModelIntro
data.value: The 7KS charges on one phase, the 22KT on three. Gleanvolt checks its charge control against it when the plugin next connects; restart the plugin after a change.

data.name: NoStatus
data.value: The SCharger reports no status, only power: with no power it reads Unknown, whether a car is plugged in or not.

data.name: PortHint
data.value: Modbus TCP: 502, unless it was changed in the charger's settings.
